CORRECTION_1_HISTORICAL_OVERCLAIM.withdrawn: the generator was never the binding constraint
CORRECTION_1_HISTORICAL_OVERCLAIM.adopted: the observation model was the dominant shared bottleneck revealed by the Step-3 experiments, so the earlier 37 generator failures cannot be cleanly attributed to generator structure alone
CORRECTION_1_HISTORICAL_OVERCLAIM.why: the stronger sentence asserts something never tested; the 37 candidates were never re-run under the repaired observer

CORRECTION_2_EVALUATION_UNIVERSE_WAS_NOT.defect: every candidate was independently prevalence-filtered on its OWN counts before topology was scored, giving vertex sets of 12,468 to 28,884 genes against a canonical 19,569. Topology was compared across different graphs.
CORRECTION_2_EVALUATION_UNIVERSE_WAS_NOT.why_it_biases_upward: an observer that makes canonical genes vanish was rewarded with a smaller, easier graph instead of being penalised for losing them

fix.rule: undetected genes remain zero columns and contribute nothing, which is the penalty

CORRECTION_3_HEADLINE_NUMBERS_WERE_INFLA.retracted_claim: the previously reported essentially-exact match of frac>0.3 at 0.6154 against a real 0.6148 and mean degree 1846 against 1844 does NOT hold on the canonical universe
CORRECTION_3_HEADLINE_NUMBERS_WERE_INFLA.the_decisive_new_fact: the deterministic arm destroys 9,964 of 19,569 canonical genes, more than half the real universe. Under per-arm filtering that destruction was invisible because topology was then scored only on the survivors.
CORRECTION_3_HEADLINE_NUMBERS_WERE_INFLA.abundance_also_outside_envelope: 7625.8 deterministic and 26753.4 Poisson against a frozen envelope of 1804.75 to 2187.67, so the abundance claim is downgraded from demonstrated to untested

WHAT_SURVIVES_THE_CORRECTION.qualitative_finding_holds: between two arms identical in generator, capture, cell state, abundance, rate field and seed, stochastic counting ALONE collapses transitivity from 0.7645 to 0.3555 and mean degree from 1561.8 to 8.4
WHAT_SURVIVES_THE_CORRECTION.abundance_compression_no_longer_required: still supported in direction, since the full abundance term is retained in both arms, but the marginal is not yet inside its envelope

CORRECTION_4_CAUSAL_CLAIM_SOFTENED.withdrawn: the residual belongs to the generator, not the observer
CORRECTION_4_CAUSAL_CLAIM_SOFTENED.adopted: with the current fixed generator and the current biologically motivated independent-capture Poisson observer, introducing counting noise destroys the recovered dependence topology. This is consistent with insufficient latent rate dynamic range, which makes generator dynamic range the next falsifiable target.
CORRECTION_4_CAUSAL_CLAIM_SOFTENED.why: the experiment has not exhausted every biologically reasonable stochastic observation model

EXECUTABLE_PROVENANCE_NOW_COMMITTED.single_variable: realization only; generator, capture, cell state, abundance and seed identical

NEXT_SEQUENCE_ACCEPTED: 2 DONE evaluation universe frozen and comparison rerun
3 DONE deterministic-versus-Poisson executor, command, seed and receipt committed
4 freeze Observer-V2 and vary generator dynamic range ONLY
5 predeclare a small mechanistic dynamic-range family, not a continuous tuning search
6 only then Issue 2 sign and community co-calibration
7 rerun A_REPLICA when a combination is proposed for promotion
